identitySignals: Keenan's pooled programs page describes Northern California ReLiEF (NCR) as a non-profit, member owned and operated California joint powers authority for local educational agencies
Keenan, which the agenda names as administrator, is based in Torrance, CA, matching the agenda location

An earlier OUSD board item (File 19-1280) names 'Northern California ReLiEF JPA, managed by Keenan & Associates, Torrance, CA' for excess property and liability coverage, matching the 'Legal, insurance & risk' category
research.notes: No registry record (EIN, CA SOS, SAM) or dedicated contact page was found; the norcalrelief.org site did not render usable text to the fetcher. The agenda also names PRISM, a separate pool, which was not researched. Confidence is medium because the only direct identity evidence is the name match plus Keenan/Torrance and OUSD's own prior board item.

profile.summary: Northern California ReLiEF is a non-profit, member-owned joint powers authority that shares risk for public educational agencies in Northern California. It provides property and liability coverage to local school agencies. It is managed by the insurance firm Keenan.

sources.title: ReLiEF Joint Powers Authority for Public Educational Agencies Releases More Than $6 Million to Members
